## e1aaf52aaaf1

**Reproduced validator defect.** Generator source SHA-256:
`d7716ddec107cdff5efbbdb3443a1ab995eb16f29a8f4f225e55665ce7b96b8f`.
The exact 1×7 grid below passes `self_check` with no difficulty, `easy`, and
`medium`, although the advertised height domain is 6..14 and ordinary generation
cannot emit it:

```json
[[3,0,3,3,0,3,3]]
```

It has one odd one-cell component and two even two-cell components, so the
validator checks parity/count but omits shape/domain ownership. The public
Racket rule is still defined and returns `[[1,0,3,3,0,3,3]]`, recoloring the
odd component. The input is **outside** the documented ordinary generator
domain. Evidence: `checks/audit/e1aaf52aaaf1/input.json`,
`checks/audit/e1aaf52aaaf1/evidence.json`, and the supported authority receipt
`checks/audit/e1aaf52aaaf1/racket.json` (rule hash `be65021bf4da`).

**Reproduced exact-control defects.** `grid_h=6` is advertised valid but is
rejected in the easy band because generation narrows it to 7..8; `palette_kind`
`warm` and `cool` return byte-identical grids because the axis is never read;
and an unknown `typo_axis` is silently accepted. Standalone lint also reports a
missing `RULE_HASH`; defect lint reports four dead textures and domain overlap;
the override stage reports more than 14,000 findings plus 27,690 legacy-policy
multi-axis rejections. Evidence is under `checks/audit/e1aaf52aaaf1-*`.

No source was changed for this audit-only target.
